purpose: Make the existing R2 direct-EQE_EL versus reciprocity-derived delta_Vnr agreement gate executable without promoting agreement to mechanism evidence.

primary_gate.equation: d = delta_vnr_direct_mV - delta_vnr_reciprocity_mV; gate = abs(d) <= 20 mV
primary_gate.threshold_provenance: inherited planning window from technical/current-specification.md; not standards-derived
pass_requires: same frozen temperature target and recorded measured temperature
same declared injection/reference condition where applicable
independent analysis provenance for direct and reciprocity paths
raw/minimally processed source-data references for both paths
declared uncertainty components and correlation treatment

uncertainty_diagnostic.rho_definition: declared correlation coefficient for shared systematic uncertainty between the two delta_Vnr estimates
uncertainty_diagnostic.interpretation: diagnostic only; uncertainty does not relax the 20 mV engineering screen

states.PASS: all provenance/configuration requirements complete and abs(d) <= 20 mV
states.FAIL: all provenance/configuration requirements complete and abs(d) > 20 mV, or a frozen invalidating condition is present
states.INCOMPLETE: required data, provenance, uncertainty/correlation declaration, or configuration matching is missing

statistical_unit: substrate for fabrication inference; paired pixel-level concordance is a metrology observation and does not increase fabrication N
predefined_exclusions: unsafe/damaged sample state that invalidates acquisition
non_exclusions: result that weakens a mechanism narrative
conventional_explanations: spectral truncation or low-signal tail bias
shared calibration systematic that makes two paths agree spuriously
claim_boundary: PASS establishes only metrology-path concordance under the tested configuration. It is not evidence of EPC, open-quantum transport, improved efficiency, or facility equivalence.
